Hi Liam —

Appreciate the sample, that helps. Short answers up front and then a concise checklist below:

Summary: Portal-first, email backchannel allowed temporarily, PO number must be present in a dedicated column (preferred) or in the subject line if vendor can't change payloads. PDF stamping is helpful but not required if PO column exists.

Required invoice fields (CSV preferred):
- invoice_number (string, unique)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number (string)
- vendor_name
- line_description
- quantity (numeric)
- unit_price (decimal)
- currency (ISO 4217)
- line_total (decimal)
- tax_amount (decimal, optional but recommended)
- remit_to_entity (string)
- tax_id_or_vat (string)

Notes:
- Column names should be lowercase and underscored as above where possible. We can accept mapping on upload but the sooner you align, the fewer manual steps our onboarding ops team will need.
- For email fallback: send PDFs + the CSV payload to procurement@redwood.com with subject containing the PO number as "PO: <po_number>". We'll accept this path for legacy ERPs for 60 days post-go-live while you complete exporter changes. After that, the portal is required for automated processing.

I've attached a lightweight template (redwood_invoice_template_v1.csv) and a short mapping guide. Also filing an onboarding task in HubSpot (HS-46281) so our ops lead can follow up.

Next steps:
1) Confirm you can add a po_number column in your export or agree to include PO in email subject.
2) If you want, pick a 15-min slot and we can screen-share the portal CSV mapping UI.

Best,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
